verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP is a remote server reached programmatically. Its docs show code-based connection with bearer-token and project/environment headers, plus TypeScript, Python and Java SDKs and a REST API, so non-interactive, headless use from scripts is documented. Nothing addresses CI pipelines, non-interactive credential setup for automation, or running in a CI runner. End-user account connection relies on a user-facing connect flow. Missing for 10: CI/CD-specific documentation or examples, a documented non-interactive service-credential flow for automation, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
